verdict.rationale: OpenTofu is an open-source CLI that users install and run on their own machines across many OSes and install methods. It is guaranteed 'truly open source' under the Linux Foundation, its source is on GitHub, and state can be stored locally. Community reports describe teams migrating client projects and running it in place of Terraform. Missing for 10: explicit license terms surfaced in the docs (a community comment notes the license appears only in the GitHub repo), and documentation on self-hosting the surrounding pieces such as state backends or a registry.
